newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa industrials up on host of bullish factors.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa industrials up on host of bullish factors.

text.p: A host of bullish factors powered industrial shares sharply higher on Monday as golds continued to sag on a struggling bullion price.
Dealers said bullish January reserves data and a stronger Wall Street on Friday, coupled with a firmer rand and strong long bonds on Monday helped the market extend its Friday gains in busy trade.
Good demand for shares came from foreigners and futures players with over 800 million rand worth of shares changing hands in active trade, dealers said.
The overall index added 76.4 points to 6,956.0 points, the industrial index rose 83.5 points to 8,286.5 and the gold index lost 7.1 points to 1,350.4.
